# The burden of saying no repeatedly

A booking form that says optional still requires a person to refuse an expectation. Supported practice needs a way to stop without a long explanation. I want to study where the refusal becomes socially expensive. [[Field methods]]: ask about the encounter itself before inventing a personality trait called reluctance.
